```aether
  }
```
```aether
}
```

```aether
procedure MoveDailySummary {
  about "Tell the owner how many customers are booked"
  policy MovePolicy
  sheet Moves "Moves" { customer: Text, phone: Phone, move_date: Date, crew: Text, deposit: Money, estimate: Money, status: Text, access_notes: Text private }
  trigger every day at 07:00

  let all = fetch Moves
  let these = filter all where status == "booked" and days_between(move_date, today()) <= 14
  let n = summarize count of these
  let total = summarize sum estimate of these
  let avg = summarize avg estimate of these
  if n == 0 {
    stop "no booked customers"
  }
  notify owner "Booked customers: {n}, total estimate: {total}, avg estimate: {avg}"
}
```
